Class BlazeBiteTools.FirestoreNumericField

public class BlazeBiteTools.FirestoreNumericField

Wrapper for a Firestore numeric field that may arrive as either integerValue (string) or doubleValue.

public Decimal getDecimalValue()

Returns the decimal value, defaulting to 0 if both representations are blank/null.

public Decimal getDecimalValue(Decimal defaultValue)

Returns the decimal value, defaulting to the provided value if both representations are blank/null. Rounds to 2 decimal places when the double value has more than 2 decimals.

Parameters:
    defaultValue – The fallback value.

Returns:
    Decimal: the parsed value or defaultValue.
